_comment_meta: FastFlag preset for Roblox performance. Written to ClientAppSettings.json in every
Versions\version-XXXX\ClientSettings\ folder the script finds under Roblox Player
IMPORTANT (late 2025): The PCClient (RobloxPlayerBeta.exe) only honors flags on an
internal ALLOWLIST since 2025-09-30. Flags outside it are silently ignored at runtime.
Studio still honors every flag. All flags below are historically-known-to-help entries;
some will do nothing on the Player and still matter for Studio work.
FFlag*  = static bool          DFFlag* = dynamic bool
FInt*   = static int           DFInt*  = dynamic int
FString*= static string        DFString* = dynamic string
_comment_quality: Force a starting graphics quality level (1 = lowest / 10 = highest / 21 = Auto). Overrides the in-game slider on launch.
_comment_renderer: Pick which graphics backend the client uses. Only one of these should be true. D3D11 is the default on Windows; Vulkan is faster on many AMD GPUs; D3D10 is a fallback for very old machines.
_comment_fps: Target FPS the task scheduler aims at. Works with the native in-game 'Maximum Frame Rate' slider.
_comment_textures: Downgrade textures across the board — biggest VRAM / bandwidth win on low-end GPUs.
_comment_terrain: Smaller terrain chunks = less mesh work per frame (at the cost of more draw calls).
_comment_telemetry_and_misc: Skip per-frame telemetry counters & similar background work. Small but free wins.
_comment_shadow_quality: Trim shadow work. Set false if you want pretty shadows back.
_comment_mesh_and_lod: Eagerly drop distant mesh detail. Trades visual pop-in for CPU time.
_comment_memory: Stop the client from pre-loading every font it ships with on startup.
_comment_sound: Lower audio-mix overhead a touch on weak CPUs. Set back to defaults if you notice audio glitches.
